about: An epic platform fighter for up to 8 players online or locally. Try casual free-for-alls, ranked matches, or invite friends to a private room. And it's free!
Play cross-platform with millions of players on PS4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, iOS, Android and Steam! Frequent updates. Over fifty Legends.

Game modes include: Ranked 1v1 and 2v2 online play 4 Player Online Free-for-All 8 Player 4v4 & Free-for-All Local Free for All Local Custom Teams Alternate Game Modes - Brawlball, Bombsketball and more.
